x.constraints: Caller supplies nonempty finite mono audio at the expected sample rate; forward does not decode or resample.

attention_mask.values: 1 or True for real samples, 0 or False for padding
attention_mask.native_handling: Cast to bool, stride-subsample to the feature-frame count, then truncate before conformer attention. No exact mask-equivalence or padded-batch numerical guarantee is made.

last_hidden_state.semantics: Contextual audio features taken from hidden_states[-1].

hidden_states.indexing: Index 0 is the conv front end output (conformer input); index k is the output of conformer block k; index 12 is block 12 after the encoder LayerNorm and is last_hidden_state. Every state is built on every forward pass.

outputs.frame_count: T is the native feature-frame count determined by the input length and frontend; nominal label rate is 25 Hz, not an exact frame-count formula.

adapter_embedding.type: tuple of numpy.ndarray, one per stored layer
adapter_embedding.layer_numbering: Layer n is hidden_states[n - 1]: layer 1 is the conv front end, layer k + 1 follows conformer block k, layer 13 is last_hidden_state.

inference.dtype: float16 conv and conformer under CUDA autocast; float32 mel front end; float32 on CPU
inference.autocast: cuda float16, mel front end excluded because its power spectrum overflows float16

adapter.window_selection: Consecutive full-track windows with a final window aligned to the track end.
adapter.pooling: For each stored layer: mean its hidden state over time; L2-normalize each window vector; mean window vectors; final L2 normalization.
adapter.batch_memory: Only pooled window vectors outlive a forward pass; each batch's hidden states are released before the next batch.
